bio.text: Brian Mast represents Florida's 21st Congressional District in his fifth term and chairs the House Foreign Affairs Committee.
He served in the U.S. Army for more than 12 years as a bomb disposal expert, was wounded in Afghanistan, and received medals including the Bronze Star and the Purple Heart.
After leaving the Army he worked as an explosive specialist with the Department of Homeland Security and received a degree from Harvard University.
He lives in Fort Pierce, Florida.
